scripts.setup: npm install && npm run hooks:install && npm run pull-keys && npm run gen:workerd-env
scripts.hooks:install: git rev-parse --git-dir > /dev/null 2>&1 && git config core.hooksPath .githooks || true
scripts.openapi:generate: npm run --workspace=backend openapi:dump:offline && npm run --workspace=admin openapi:client && npm run --workspace=store openapi:client
scripts.typecheck: npm run --workspace=backend typecheck && npm run --workspace=store typecheck && npm run --workspace=admin typecheck
scripts.pull-keys: npx wrangler r2 object get dotenv-keys/.env.keys --file=.env.keys --remote
